attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 15 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2, and node3 (standbys) on RHEL 7.9, secured with TLS using a cluster-specific CA, restricting replication connections to peers presenting CA-issued client certificates. All three nodes were restarted one at a time (standbys first, primary last) with quorum preserved throughout; each node's changed boot identity and full recovery of PostgreSQL service, replication, and data were verified.
